description.zh-CN: 生成八秒横屏叙事镜头，强调环境、人物动作与电影光影。
description.en-US: Generate an eight-second horizontal narrative shot with cinematic lighting and character motion.

zh-CN.prompt: 电影感叙事镜头，真实环境与人物，镜头缓慢移动，动作自然连续，层次丰富的光影，明确的前中后景，画面稳定

en-US.prompt: Cinematic narrative shot with a realistic environment and character, slow camera movement, natural continuous action, layered lighting, clear foreground midground and background
